site.name: Terra & Co.
site.tagline: Considered home goods for slower living
site.description: Terra & Co. designs lighting, storage and textiles made to last, sourced from small workshops and shipped in plastic-free packaging.

hero.headline: Everyday objects, made to be kept
hero.subheadline: Small-batch lighting, storage and textiles designed with repairable parts and honest materials.

benefits.title: Honest materials
benefits.body: Solid ash, waxed canvas and undyed wool — nothing that pretends to be something it isn't.

benefits.title: Built to repair
benefits.body: Every lamp ships with a spare fuse and a five-year parts guarantee, not a replacement policy.

benefits.title: Small workshops
benefits.body: Made in batches of under 200 by four partner workshops we visit twice a year.

benefits.title: Plastic-free packaging
benefits.body: Molded pulp, paper tape and soy ink. Compostable at home, not just 'recyclable'.

testimonial.quote: The desk lamp is the first thing I've bought in years that I don't want to upgrade.
testimonial.author: Reader survey, 2025

products.name: Aurora Desk Lamp
products.shortDescription: A dimmable ash-and-brass desk lamp with a three-step brightness dial.
products.description: The Aurora pairs a turned ash base with a brushed brass shade so the warm light lands on your desk, not your eyes. The dial has three fixed brightness steps rather than a fiddly slider, and the fabric cord is long enough to route around a monitor arm.

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: Solid ash base, brushed brass shade

specs.label: Bulb
specs.value: E27, 6W LED included, dimmable in 3 steps

products.name: Halo Floor Lamp
products.shortDescription: An arched floor lamp with a linen shade and a weighted marble foot.
products.description: A gentle arch in powder-coated steel holds a linen shade over a weighted marble foot, so it reads as a piece of furniture rather than a fixture.

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: Powder-coated steel, linen shade, marble foot

products.name: Solstice Table Lamp
products.shortDescription: A squat stoneware lamp with a hand-glazed finish; no two are identical.
products.description: Thrown in stoneware and finished with a reactive glaze, so colour and texture vary slightly piece to piece — that variation is the point.

products.name: Weave Storage Basket
products.shortDescription: A hand-woven seagrass basket with reinforced leather handles.
products.description: Woven from seagrass by a partner workshop, with leather handles riveted rather than stitched so they hold up to years of daily use.

products.name: Modular Shelf Unit
products.shortDescription: A five-tier ash shelving unit that expands with add-on modules.
products.description: Solid ash uprights and shelves that lock together without hardware, so the unit can grow one module at a time.

products.name: Cedar Storage Bench
products.shortDescription: An entryway bench with a lift-up seat and cedar-lined storage.
products.description: The cedar lining keeps the storage cavity naturally moth-resistant, which matters if it's doubling as a blanket box.

products.name: Linen Throw Blanket
products.shortDescription: A stonewashed linen throw that softens with every wash.
products.description: Woven in a mid-weight linen and stonewashed before shipping, so it already has the soft, worn-in hand you'd expect after a year of use.

products.name: Wool Area Rug
products.shortDescription: An undyed wool rug, flat-woven in a single natural fleece tone.
products.description: Left undyed so the natural variation in the fleece shows through, this flat weave lies well over underfloor heating.

products.name: Canvas Floor Cushion
products.shortDescription: A waxed-canvas floor cushion with a removable, washable cover.
products.description: Dense enough to hold its shape on a hard floor, with a zip closure hidden along the seam so the cover comes off for washing.

products.name: Foldable Picnic Table
products.shortDescription: A folding oak picnic table that packs flat into a car boot.
products.description: Folds flat in two motions without tools, and the oiled oak top is finished to handle rain without staining.

products.name: Portable Fire Pit
products.shortDescription: A low-smoke steel fire pit that packs into its own carry case.
products.description: The double-wall steel design draws air through the base for a cleaner, lower-smoke burn, and it packs into a canvas case once cooled.

products.name: Camp Hammock Chair
products.shortDescription: A cotton-canvas hanging chair with a folding beechwood spreader bar.
products.description: The beechwood spreader bar folds in half so the whole chair rolls into a bag small enough for a daypack.
